comments: Creates a new custom OAuth scope for a CIMD Domain. You must specify the Id of the CIMD domain you are creating the scope for.
You can optionally specify an Id for the OAuth scope on the URL, if not provided one will be generated.

params.name: domainId
comments: The Id of the CIMD domain to create the OAuth scope on.

params.name: scopeId
comments: (Optional) The Id of the OAuth scope. If not provided a secure random UUID will be generated.

params.name: request
comments: The request object that contains all the information used to create the OAuth scope.
